entities.summary: Samir Yacoub Brikho FREng is a Lebanese-Swedish global businessman. He served as the Executive Chairman at fertilizer producer EuroChem Group AG, Chairman of the Board of Directors of SUEK AG, Chief Executive Officer of Amec Foster Wheeler, and other senior executive roles at ABB and ALSTOM.
